scenario: The ego vehicle goes straight through an intersection while approaching a vehicle ahead and a stationary shared bicycle on the zebra crossing.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward through the intersection.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward ahead of the ego vehicle in the same lane.
The bicycle remains stationary horizontally across the zebra crossing.

spatial_relation: On a two-way two-lane intersection, the ego vehicle is in the bottom lane approaching the intersection, a target vehicle is directly ahead in the same lane, and a stationary shared bicycle lies horizontally across the zebra crossing at the intersection.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must spawn a set distance behind the target vehicle and the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has traveled through the intersection.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the green car from first-person perspective; blue car ahead and shared bicycle are adversarials. 2. Enumeration: two adversarials (one Car, one Bicycle). 3. Chronology: initially ego approaches intersection with car ahead and bicycle on crossing; midpoint ego continues straight; ending ego passes through. 4. Evidence: blue car maintains position ahead; bicycle stays fixed horizontally on zebra crossing.
